messages:
jamie_support: FYI customer ACME hit us — their month-end invoice is ~4.2k higher than the dashboard. Invoice has a mysterious 'embeddings-usage-overage' line with 12,389 tokens, dashboard export shows 7,912 tokens. Ticket INC-4251. Can someone triage? :eyes:

ben_billing: On it. Do we have the raw invoice JSON and the dashboard CSV export? Also what cutoff window did ACME use?

jamie_support: Pasted both to the ticket. Dashboard export CSV: https://redwood.app/exports/ACME_jun_report.csv (private link). Invoice JSON attached to the billing ticket.

metricbot: Automated export complete — billing_invoice: {"account":"acme","period":"2024-06-01_to_2024-06-30","token_total":12389,"lines":[{"desc":"embeddings-usage-overage","tokens":12389}]}

ben_billing: Running the reconciliation query now. Can you run this quick check in prod-analytics?

ben_billing: ```sql
SELECT account_id, date_trunc('minute', event_ts) AS minute, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE account_id = 'acme' AND event_ts >= '2024-06-01' AND event_ts < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY account_id, minute
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

ben_billing: Results show two high-count rows around the boundary. Copying snippet:
```
account_id | minute               | tokens
acme       | 2024-06-30T23:59:00Z |  4789
acme       | 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z |  7600
```

ben_billing: That 07-01 00:00 row is in the invoice ingestion window due to UTC boundary, but our dashboard export (org-level UI) applied a cutoff in local timezone for ACME (UTC-7). So dashboard excluded the 00:00Z events which are 17:00 PDT, but invoice ingestion used UTC.

cara_finance: If that's true we need to either adjust invoice or explain to customer. How many tokens are attributable to that 00:00Z block?

ben_billing: 7600 tokens in that minute, which accounts for the delta (~12,389 invoice vs 7,912 dashboard ≈ 4,477 difference). Looks like backfill/job replay created that extra minute — I see a reingestion job from 2024-07-01 00:05Z in the logs. Link: https://logs.redwood/app?job_id=ingest-20240701-xyz

sre_rob: cc @ben_billing I rotated the ingestion worker yesterday; there was a malformed retry where the backfill window overlapped the month boundary. I can revert the duplicate records and mark them as "reconciled" in the meter.

ben_billing: Suggested fix steps:
1) Identify duplicate event_ids in embeddings_events for account 'acme' with event_ts between '2024-06-30T23:50:00Z' and '2024-07-01T00:10:00Z'.
2) Compare event_ids against invoice_billing_snapshot for June.
3) Remove duplicates from billing snapshot and recompute token_total.

ben_billing: Quick SQL to find dups:
```sql
SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE account_id='acme' AND event_ts >= '2024-06-30T23:50:00Z' AND event_ts < '2024-07-01T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 50;
```

jamie_support: Should we inform the customer or wait for the corrected invoice? They pinged support already.

cara_finance: Finance prefers we notify with a provisional note: "We have identified a meter ingestion overlap affecting your June invoice. We expect to issue a corrected invoice within 24 hours or apply a credit. Working on root cause." I'll sign off on credits once billing confirms numbers.

ben_billing: I'll run the dedupe script now (dry-run first) and attach the diff. If tokens drop by ~7600 we'll issue a credit for the delta. Dry-run showing -7598 tokens in snapshot.

metricbot: Billing snapshot diff generated: {"account":"acme","original_tokens":12389,"reconciled_tokens":4789,"delta":-7600}

jamie_support: Thanks — I'll send an update to the customer with the provisional note and link to the ticket.

cara_finance: Approved provisional credit once dedupe confirmed. :thumbsup:

ben_billing: Dedup completed and invoice snapshot updated. New invoice will reflect tokens=4789. I'll trigger reissue and finalize with finance.

jamie_support: Customer updated: "Thanks for the quick turnaround, appreciate the transparency." Closing loop after reissue. :white_check_mark:

sre_rob: Root cause: ingestion retry/backfill didn't respect month-end cutoff for a subset of accounts in UTC conversions. I've pushed a hotfix to the ingestion service to freeze retries across month boundaries and added a unit test. Will follow up with a postmortem.

jamie_support: tagging for postmortem: @sre_rob @ben_billing @cara_finance. Marking this thread resolved for support.
